events.title: Coffee & Conversation: September 2026
events.description:
Mornings are better when we get together. ☕️ 
Imagine starting your day with a vibrant buzz, not just from your coffee, but from connecting with fellow local innovators. Our monthly Coffee & Conversation event is designed to do just that. 
Join us on the second Thursday of every month at 8:30 AM for a morning of free coffee, delicious donuts and making valuable connections that can help propel your business forward. This event is specifically crafted to bring Fishers businesses and entrepreneurs

events.title: Free Cowork Friday: September 2026
events.description:
Each month (usually on the final Friday), we open our doors to anyone interested in trying out coworking! Potential new members can come in and enjoy free coffee & coworking as they test drive what a Launch Fishers membership is all about. We provide a reliable place to work for all sorts of people: entrepreneurs, remote workers, consultants, and more! 
Benefits of Launch Fishers membership: a comfortable workspace, a great community of fellow coworkers, phone booths, meeting & conference rooms,
